I read the plate as a square dinner plate about 24 cm across. The greens sit in a pile roughly 10 cm wide, which covers about 15% of the plate. The pile is loose and airy, so I judged it at about 3 cm high.

Arugula leaves are very light. Loosely packed, that volume works out to about 25 g.

A few thin strips of carrot are scattered through and on the plate, about 3 g in total.

The leaves look slightly glossy, so there may be a light coating of dressing. I estimated about 4 g.
